requirements.businessContext: League Setup covers the full lifecycle of a league as a top-level entity: the superadmin creates leagues of one of five variants (TVT-8, TVT-16, TVT-32, Triple Crown, Auction Primary/Complete), each with its own format-specific defaults, validation rules, and auto-provisioned placeholder team accounts. Once created, the league can be renamed, deactivated, reactivated, or hard-deleted by the superadmin, and its per-league reveal flags (captain/chip/groups) can be toggled by any assigned admin. A rate-limited 'reset season' action wipes scoring artifacts while preserving the team roster and groups. Team and fixture management are explicitly out of scope for this module.

userStories.iWant: to create a new TVT league of size 8, 16, or 32
userStories.soThat: I can launch a Tournament-vs-Tournament season with the right number of teams and groups

userStories.iWant: to create a Triple Crown league with all settings hardcoded
userStories.soThat: the cup+league hybrid format is provisioned consistently every season without me re-entering the same values

userStories.iWant: to create a JPL Auction league with a chosen tier (Primary or Complete) and optional PL Club Auction
userStories.soThat: I can offer the lighter Primary variant or the fully-featured Complete variant with trades and slot expansion

userStories.iWant: creating any league to auto-provision placeholder team accounts with deterministic login IDs and temporary passwords
userStories.soThat: I do not have to hand-create dozens of accounts and teams can self-onboard via the /setup wizard on first login

userStories.iWant: TVT teams to be pre-allocated into PL groups by a randomised even split at creation time
userStories.soThat: I have a sensible starting grouping the admin can re-shuffle later from the Groups tab before reveal

userStories.iWant: to list every league in the system with team count and current gameweek
userStories.soThat: I can see at a glance the overall portfolio I administer

userStories.iWant: to rename a league, change its season, toggle active/inactive, or update enabled chips
userStories.soThat: I can adjust a league mid-stream without recreating it

userStories.iWant: to permanently delete a league after re-entering my password
userStories.soThat: I can reclaim a defunct league's slug and clean up its tree of data, but only with an explicit confirmation gate

userStories.iWant: to view and toggle the captain-reveal, chip-reveal, and groups-reveal flags for my league
userStories.soThat: I control when sensitive per-team picks are visible to other teams

userStories.iWant: to reset the current season for my league after re-entering my password
userStories.soThat: I can wipe all scoring artifacts (teams, fixtures, results, chips, captains) and start a fresh season without losing admin assignments, groups, or settings

userStories.iWant: the reset-season endpoint to be hard-rate-limited
userStories.soThat: an accidental double click cannot wipe my league's data twice in succession

userStories.iWant: to fetch the set of leagues I have access to, with team count and current gameweek
userStories.soThat: the picker page can show me my assigned leagues only, not the platform-wide list

userStories.iWant: to read the list of active leagues without signing in
userStories.soThat: I can browse what's available before deciding to join

userStories.iWant: league creation to be transactional with cascading rollback on failure
userStories.soThat: a partial failure cannot leave orphan team rows or half-configured groups in the database

userStories.iWant: inactive leagues to disappear from my picker
userStories.soThat: I cannot accidentally administer a league the superadmin has paused

businessRules.rule: Both GET and POST /api/superadmin/leagues require a superadmin session; non-superadmin (admin, team, anonymous) requests return 403 'Superadmin access required'.
Creating a league requires `slug`, `name`, `sport`, `format`, and `season` in the body; missing any of the five returns 400 'slug, name, sport, format, and season are required'.
Slug must be globally unique; an existing slug returns 409 'A league with slug "<slug>" already exists' (pre-checked before insert; the UNIQUE constraint failure path also returns the same 409).

Only the formats 'tvt', 'triple-crown', and 'auction' are accepted at creation time; any other value (including 'classic', 'grand-prix', or arbitrary strings) returns 400 'Format "<format>" is not supported'.
For format='triple-crown', the server hardcodes teamSize=20, groupCount=4, playoffStartGw=27, enabledChips=[] and ignores any client-supplied values for those fields.
For format='tvt', resolvedTeamSize = client teamSize ?? 32; the value must be exactly 8, 16, or 32 — anything else returns 400 'TVT teamSize must be 8, 16, or 32'.
For format='tvt', resolvedGroupCount defaults to 2 when teamSize=32 and to 1 for teamSize=8 or 16 (unless overridden by client). The route does not range-check groupCount itself.

For format='tvt', resolvedPlayoffStartGw defaults to 36 when teamSize=8 and 31 otherwise; the supplied value must be between 31 and 36 inclusive or 400 'TVT playoffStartGw must be between 31 and 36' is returned. For TVT-8 with the default of 36, the playoff stage spans GW36-GW38 (three gameweeks total): Semi-finals are a single-leg tie at GW36, and both the Final and the 3rd-Place play-off are two-leg ties scheduled at GW37 (leg 1) + GW38 (leg 2). The playoffs helper isPlayoffs() treats every gameweek in [playoffStartGw, 38] as playoff, and ensurePlayoffGws() auto-creates the GW rows for that range — so playoffStartGw=36 is fully runnable end-to-end.

For format='tvt', enabledChips defaults to ['D','W','C'] and must be a JSON array of exactly 3 entries, each in the set {W,D,C,SL,CB,UD}, with no duplicates; otherwise 400 'TVT enabledChips must be an array of exactly 3 unique valid chip codes (W, D, C, SL, CB, UD)' is returned.
For format='auction', resolvedTeamSize defaults to 10, groupCount is forced to 0, playoffStartGw is forced to 39 (effectively no playoffs), and enabledChips is forced to [].
For format='auction', initialBudget defaults to 100_000_000 when not supplied; for any other format the field is always set to 100_000_000 regardless of client input.

auctionTier is meaningful only for auction leagues: client value of literal 'primary' yields 'primary', anything else (including 'complete', undefined, typos, non-strings) yields 'complete'. Non-auction formats also resolve to 'complete'.
isSimulated is honoured only for auction leagues (defaulting to false); for TVT and Triple Crown the column is hard-set to false regardless of input.
clubAuctionEnabled is honoured only for auction leagues (Boolean-coerced from input); for TVT and Triple Crown it is hard-set to false regardless of input.

On successful creation the league row is inserted with isActive=true and the response payload echoes id, slug, name, sport, format, season, isActive=true, teamSize, groupCount, playoffStartGw, enabledChips (as array), teamCount (== resolvedTeamSize), and currentGameweek=null.

For TVT leagues only, the create transaction pre-creates PL groups: groupCount=2 → groups named 'A' and 'B' with groupType='pl'; groupCount=1 → a single group 'A'. Triple Crown and Auction create no groups in this route.

For TVT, team-to-group allocation is a Fisher-Yates shuffle of [1..teamSize] then sliced evenly (ceil(teamSize/groupCount) per group); the last group receives the remainder when teamSize is not evenly divisible.

Every format auto-creates exactly `resolvedTeamSize` placeholder team rows; each row has teamLoginId='<slug>Team<i>', name='Team <i>', password=bcrypt('Team@<2-digit-padded-i>', 10), mustChangePassword=true, isProfileComplete=false.
For auction leagues, every placeholder team row has its `purse` initialised to resolvedBudget (== initialBudget); non-auction formats do not write a purse value.
League creation runs inside a single DB transaction (`db.transaction`); any insert failure (league, group, or team) rolls back the entire batch so no orphan rows persist.

If the team-insert step fails because a teamLoginId already exists globally (UNIQUE on teams.team_login_id / teams_login_id_global_unique), the route returns 409 with a recovery hint: 'Cannot create league: team login IDs like "<slug>Team1" are already in use globally. … Run scripts/cleanup-orphan-teams.ts or pick a different slug.'.

Any other unexpected DB error during creation returns 500 'Failed to create league: <message-chain>' where the message chain walks up to 5 levels of `.cause` so the underlying SQLite/libsql reason surfaces.
GET /api/superadmin/leagues attaches teamCount and currentGameweek to each row and orders results by `createdAt` ascending.

GET /api/superadmin/leagues has a defensive fallback: if the full SELECT throws (e.g., because the auction_tier column is missing pending migration), it retries with a minimal projection and synthesises auctionTier='complete' for every row.
PATCH /api/superadmin/leagues/[id] accepts only `name` (string), `season` (string), `isActive` (boolean), and `enabledChips` (array → stringified JSON); any other body field is silently ignored.
PATCH /api/superadmin/leagues/[id] returns 400 'No valid fields to update' when none of the four whitelisted fields is present (or all are wrong type).

PATCH /api/superadmin/leagues/[id] invalidates the league page cache (`invalidateLeaguePageCache`) after the update and responds `{success:true}` — note: it does NOT re-validate enabledChips against the 3-of-{W,D,C,SL,CB,UD} rule applied at creation. // CODE-CONFIRMED: may be a defect — confirm with product owner: PATCH lets a superadmin write any array (e.g., 4 chips, or codes outside the valid set) to enabledChips.

DELETE /api/superadmin/leagues/[id] requires the superadmin's own password in the body (`password`); missing returns 400 'Password is required to confirm deletion', wrong returns 403 'Incorrect password'.
DELETE /api/superadmin/leagues/[id] returns 401 'Not authenticated' when the x-session-id header is missing, and 404 'User not found' if the session ID does not resolve to a users row.
DELETE /api/superadmin/leagues/[id] returns 404 'League not found' when the league ID does not exist.

DELETE /api/superadmin/leagues/[id] cascades inside a transaction in a fixed order: results → challengerSurvivalEntries → gameweekChips → fixtures → playoffTies → players → auction (bids, wishlists, ownership, scores, tradeProposals, sessions) → settings → leagueAdmins → teams → groups → gameweeks → league. On success returns `{success:true, message:'League "<name>" and all its data have been permanently deleted.'}`.

GET /api/admin/[leagueId]/settings returns `{captainAnnouncementEnabled, chipAnnouncementEnabled, groupsRevealed}` derived from the settings table, with defaults: captainAnnouncementEnabled=true (only false when the row literally stores 'false'), chipAnnouncementEnabled=true (same rule), groupsRevealed=false (only true when the row literally stores 'true').

POST /api/admin/[leagueId]/settings requires `{key,value}` with key in {captainAnnouncementEnabled, chipAnnouncementEnabled, groupsRevealed} and value strictly a boolean; missing key or non-boolean value returns 400 'key and boolean value are required'; out-of-set key returns 400 'Invalid setting key'.

POST /api/admin/[leagueId]/settings upserts the row keyed by (key, leagueId), storing value as its string form ('true'/'false') and updating updatedAt; on success returns `{success:true, key, value}`.
Both /api/admin/[leagueId]/settings handlers route through getAuthorizedLeagueId — non-admin/non-superadmin sessions, missing assignments, or inactive leagues (for admins) yield 403 'Forbidden'.

POST /api/admin/[leagueId]/reset-season requires `password` in body; missing → 400 'Password is required', wrong → 403 'Incorrect password'. The session user must have role 'admin' or 'superadmin' or the route returns 401 'Unauthorized'.

POST /api/admin/[leagueId]/reset-season deletes (in a single transaction) challengerSurvivalEntries, auditLogs, gameweekChips, gameweekCaptains, results, playoffTies, fixtures, players, teams, and gameweeks for the league; it preserves users (admin assignments), groups, and settings.

POST /api/admin/[leagueId]/reset-season invalidates the league page cache and returns `{success:true, message, deleted:[teams,players,gameweeks,fixtures,results,gameweek_captains,gameweek_chips,playoff_ties,challenger_survival_entries,audit_logs], preserved:[users,groups,settings]}`.

Reset-season is rate-limited at the middleware layer to 1 successful POST per IP per 60 seconds across ALL leagues — a second call within the window returns 429 'Too many requests. Please try again later.'.
GET /api/admin/my-leagues requires sessionType 'admin' or 'superadmin'; team or anonymous returns 403 'Admin access required'.

GET /api/admin/my-leagues returns ALL leagues (active and inactive) for superadmin sessions, and only the union of (a) leagues the session ID appears against in leagueAdmins AND (b) league.isActive=true for non-superadmin admin sessions.
GET /api/admin/my-leagues attaches teamCount and currentGameweek per league and orders by createdAt ascending.

GET /api/leagues is public (no session required) and returns only rows where isActive=true with a fixed projection: {id, slug, name, sport, format, season, teamSize, isActive, enabledChips, playoffStartGw}.
When an admin (non-superadmin) calls any /api/admin/[leagueId]/* endpoint against an inactive league they are assigned to, getAuthorizedLeagueId returns null and the route responds 403 'Forbidden'.

getAuthorizedLeagueId accepts EITHER the league UUID or the league slug in the URL segment; slugs are resolved to UUID via a leagues-table lookup. Unknown slugs and unknown UUIDs both yield null → 403.

Each format displays a distinct visual palette derived from (format, teamSize): TVT-8 indigo, TVT-16 violet, TVT-32 purple, Triple Crown amber, Auction emerald; unknown formats fall back to the TVT-32 default palette.

On league creation the initialBudget for non-auction formats is forced to 100_000_000 even though it is meaningless for those formats. // CODE-CONFIRMED: may be a defect — confirm with product owner: the column has no functional effect for TVT/Triple Crown but is unconditionally written.

Superadmin endpoints (GET/POST /api/superadmin/leagues and GET/PATCH/DELETE /api/superadmin/leagues/[id]) are not classified as admin routes in middleware; access control is enforced inside each handler by `isSuperAdmin(request)`.

Triple Crown creation always sets groupCount=4 but the create route's group-seeding loop runs only for format='tvt' — Triple Crown cup groups are NOT created by this endpoint and are populated by a separate module.

Placeholder team passwords use a predictable pattern `Team@<NN>` (NN = team index zero-padded to two digits) — for example team #1 = 'Team@01', team #16 = 'Team@16'. Teams are forced to change this on first login (mustChangePassword=true).

acceptanceCriteria.given: a signed-in superadmin POSTs to /api/superadmin/leagues with {slug:'tvt-32-fpl',name:'TVT 32',sport:'fpl',format:'tvt',season:'2025-26',teamSize:32}
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 200 with isActive=true, teamSize=32, groupCount=2, playoffStartGw=31, enabledChips=['D','W','C'], teamCount=32, currentGameweek=null

acceptanceCriteria.given: a signed-in superadmin creates a TVT-16 league with no playoffStartGw or groupCount supplied
acceptanceCriteria.then: the row stores teamSize=16, groupCount=1, playoffStartGw=31, enabledChips=JSON.stringify(['D','W','C']) by default

acceptanceCriteria.given: a TVT POST with teamSize=12
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 400 'TVT teamSize must be 8, 16, or 32' and no rows are inserted

acceptanceCriteria.given: a TVT POST with teamSize=8 and no playoffStartGw
acceptanceCriteria.then: playoffStartGw resolves to 36

acceptanceCriteria.given: a TVT POST with playoffStartGw=30 or playoffStartGw=37
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 400 'TVT playoffStartGw must be between 31 and 36' for both

acceptanceCriteria.given: a TVT POST with enabledChips=['W','W','C']
acceptanceCriteria.when: the route validates the chip array
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 400 'TVT enabledChips must be an array of exactly 3 unique valid chip codes (W, D, C, SL, CB, UD)' (duplicate caught by Set-size check)

acceptanceCriteria.given: a TVT POST with enabledChips=['W','D','X']
acceptanceCriteria.when: the route validates the chip array
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 400 'TVT enabledChips must be an array of exactly 3 unique valid chip codes (W, D, C, SL, CB, UD)' (invalid code caught by every-includes check)

acceptanceCriteria.given: a TVT POST with enabledChips=['W','D']
acceptanceCriteria.when: the route validates the chip array
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 400 (length-3 check fails)

acceptanceCriteria.given: a TVT POST with enabledChips omitted
acceptanceCriteria.then: enabledChips defaults to ['D','W','C']

acceptanceCriteria.given: a TVT POST with enabledChips=['SL','CB','UD']
acceptanceCriteria.when: the route validates the chip array
acceptanceCriteria.then: the row is created with those three chips persisted as JSON in leagues.enabled_chips

acceptanceCriteria.given: a Triple Crown POST with client-supplied teamSize=99, groupCount=7, playoffStartGw=10
acceptanceCriteria.then: the inserted row stores teamSize=20, groupCount=4, playoffStartGw=27, enabledChips=[] regardless of client input

acceptanceCriteria.given: a Triple Crown league is created
acceptanceCriteria.then: 20 placeholder team rows exist with no group assignment (the group-seeding loop runs only for format='tvt')

acceptanceCriteria.given: an Auction POST with auctionTier='primary'
acceptanceCriteria.then: auctionTier='primary' is stored

acceptanceCriteria.given: an Auction POST with auctionTier omitted, 'Complete', 'PRIMARY', null, or any non-'primary' value
acceptanceCriteria.then: auctionTier defaults to 'complete' (only the exact literal lowercase 'primary' switches it)

acceptanceCriteria.given: an Auction POST with format='auction', teamSize=10, initialBudget=120_000_000, clubAuctionEnabled=true, isSimulated=true
acceptanceCriteria.then: the inserted row stores teamSize=10, groupCount=0, playoffStartGw=39, enabledChips=[], initialBudget=120_000_000, clubAuctionEnabled=true, isSimulated=true

acceptanceCriteria.given: a non-auction POST (e.g. TVT) with clubAuctionEnabled=true and isSimulated=true in the body
acceptanceCriteria.then: the inserted row stores clubAuctionEnabled=false and isSimulated=false (server forces them off)

acceptanceCriteria.given: an Auction league is created with teamSize=10 and initialBudget=80_000_000
acceptanceCriteria.then: all 10 placeholder team rows have purse=80_000_000

acceptanceCriteria.given: format='classic' or any other unsupported value
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 400 'Format "classic" is not supported' and no rows are inserted

acceptanceCriteria.given: a POST body missing one of slug/name/sport/format/season
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 400 'slug, name, sport, format, and season are required'

acceptanceCriteria.given: two consecutive TVT POSTs with the same slug
acceptanceCriteria.then: the second returns 409 'A league with slug "<slug>" already exists'

acceptanceCriteria.given: a TVT POST whose team-insert step trips the teams.team_login_id UNIQUE constraint
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 409 with the recovery message naming scripts/cleanup-orphan-teams.ts

acceptanceCriteria.given: any unexpected DB exception during creation
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 500 'Failed to create league: <message-chain>' walking up to 5 levels of .cause

acceptanceCriteria.given: a TVT-32 league is created
acceptanceCriteria.then: two groups 'A' and 'B' (groupType='pl') exist for that leagueId and exactly 32 team rows split 16/16 by ceil(32/2) per group

acceptanceCriteria.given: a TVT-16 league is created
acceptanceCriteria.then: exactly one group 'A' exists and all 16 team rows reference its groupId

acceptanceCriteria.given: any league is created with slug 'demo'
acceptanceCriteria.then: team #1 has teamLoginId='demoTeam1', name='Team 1', mustChangePassword=true, isProfileComplete=false, and password=bcrypt.compare('Team@01', row.password)===true

acceptanceCriteria.given: a non-superadmin (admin or team session, or no session) calls GET or POST /api/superadmin/leagues
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 403 'Superadmin access required'

acceptanceCriteria.given: a superadmin GETs /api/superadmin/leagues
acceptanceCriteria.then: each league row includes teamCount (count of teams in that leagueId) and currentGameweek (from getCurrentGameweekNumber), and the list is ordered by createdAt ascending

acceptanceCriteria.given: the leagues table is missing the auction_tier column
acceptanceCriteria.then: the route falls back to the minimal projection and returns rows with auctionTier='complete' rather than 500-ing

acceptanceCriteria.given: a superadmin PATCHes /api/superadmin/leagues/[id] with {name:'New Name',season:'2026-27',isActive:false,enabledChips:['W','D','C']}
acceptanceCriteria.then: the row reflects all four fields, the league page cache is invalidated, and the response is {success:true}

acceptanceCriteria.given: a superadmin PATCHes /api/superadmin/leagues/[id] with {slug:'new-slug'}
acceptanceCriteria.then: slug is silently dropped (not whitelisted) and the route returns 400 'No valid fields to update' because no whitelisted field is present

acceptanceCriteria.given: a superadmin PATCHes /api/superadmin/leagues/[id] with {enabledChips:['W','D','C','SL']}
acceptanceCriteria.then: the route accepts the 4-entry array and stores it verbatim — bypassing the 3-unique-of-6 creation rule (CODE-CONFIRMED: may be a defect)

acceptanceCriteria.given: a superadmin DELETEs /api/superadmin/leagues/[id] with no password in body
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 400 'Password is required to confirm deletion'

acceptanceCriteria.given: a superadmin DELETEs /api/superadmin/leagues/[id] with the wrong password
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 403 'Incorrect password' and the league is not touched

acceptanceCriteria.given: a superadmin DELETEs /api/superadmin/leagues/[id] with the correct password for a populated league
acceptanceCriteria.then: rows in results, challengerSurvivalEntries, gameweekChips, fixtures, playoffTies, players, all auction tables, settings, leagueAdmins, teams, groups, gameweeks, and leagues for that leagueId are zero

acceptanceCriteria.given: a superadmin DELETEs a non-existent league id
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 404 'League not found'

acceptanceCriteria.given: an admin or superadmin GETs /api/admin/[leagueId]/settings on a fresh league with no settings rows
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is {captainAnnouncementEnabled:true, chipAnnouncementEnabled:true, groupsRevealed:false}

acceptanceCriteria.given: an admin POSTs /api/admin/[leagueId]/settings with {key:'groupsRevealed',value:true}
acceptanceCriteria.then: a settings row exists with key='groupsRevealed', leagueId=<this>, value='true' and the subsequent GET returns groupsRevealed=true

acceptanceCriteria.given: an admin POSTs /api/admin/[leagueId]/settings with {key:'foo',value:true}
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 400 'Invalid setting key'

acceptanceCriteria.given: an admin POSTs /api/admin/[leagueId]/settings with {key:'groupsRevealed',value:'true'} (string not boolean)
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 400 'key and boolean value are required'

acceptanceCriteria.given: an admin not assigned to leagueX calls GET /api/admin/leagueX/settings
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 403 'Forbidden' (no leagueAdmins row for this user/league)

acceptanceCriteria.given: an admin calls POST /api/admin/[leagueId]/reset-season with no password
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 400 'Password is required'

acceptanceCriteria.given: an admin calls POST /api/admin/[leagueId]/reset-season with the wrong password
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 403 'Incorrect password' and no rows are deleted

acceptanceCriteria.given: a team session calls POST /api/admin/[leagueId]/reset-season
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 403 'Admin access required' (middleware) before the route runs

acceptanceCriteria.given: an admin successfully calls reset-season on a populated league
acceptanceCriteria.then: teams/players/gameweeks/fixtures/results/captains/chips/playoff_ties/challenger_survival_entries/audit_logs rows for that league are zero AND settings + leagueAdmins + groups rows remain

acceptanceCriteria.given: two reset-season POSTs from the same IP within 60 seconds
acceptanceCriteria.then: the second returns 429 'Too many requests. Please try again later.' even if it targets a different leagueId

acceptanceCriteria.given: a superadmin calls GET /api/admin/my-leagues
acceptanceCriteria.then: every league row in the system is returned (including isActive=false ones) with teamCount and currentGameweek

acceptanceCriteria.given: an admin assigned to two leagues, one active and one inactive, calls GET /api/admin/my-leagues
acceptanceCriteria.then: only the active league is returned

acceptanceCriteria.given: a team or anonymous session calls GET /api/admin/my-leagues
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 403 'Admin access required'

acceptanceCriteria.given: an anonymous request GETs /api/leagues
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 200 with only active leagues and the fixed projection {id,slug,name,sport,format,season,teamSize,isActive,enabledChips,playoffStartGw}

acceptanceCriteria.given: an admin assigned to leagueX-inactive calls POST /api/admin/leagueX-inactive/settings
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 403 'Forbidden' because the league is not active (block-inactive rule)

acceptanceCriteria.given: any /api/admin/<slug>/... call where <slug> is the league slug instead of UUID
acceptanceCriteria.then: the slug is resolved to UUID via the leagues table and access proceeds normally (or 403 if no match)

acceptanceCriteria.given: a TVT-8 league row is rendered
acceptanceCriteria.then: TVT_8_PALETTE is returned (indigo family, label 'TVT-8'); the same call for teamSize=16 returns TVT_16_PALETTE; teamSize=32 returns TVT_32_PALETTE

acceptanceCriteria.given: format='auction' or 'triple-crown'
acceptanceCriteria.then: AUCTION_PALETTE (emerald) or TC_PALETTE (amber) is returned regardless of teamSize

acceptanceCriteria.given: a TVT-8 POST simulating team-allocation 100 times
acceptanceCriteria.then: the teamIndex→groupId mapping covers all 8 team indices exactly once and (when groupCount=1) every team maps to the single group 'A'

acceptanceCriteria.given: a freshly created league with auction_tier missing from the DB but auctionTier='complete' synthesised by the fallback
acceptanceCriteria.then: no error is surfaced and the league appears alongside fully-migrated rows

testCases.scenario: Superadmin creates a TVT-32 league with full payload and receives the documented response shape
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated superadmin session with a valid x-session-id; slug 'tvt-32-fpl' is not yet in use; no teams using teamLoginId 'tvt-32-fplTeam1..32'
testCases.testData: POST /api/superadmin/leagues body={slug:'tvt-32-fpl', name:'TVT 32', sport:'fpl', format:'tvt', season:'2025-26', teamSize:32}
testSteps: 2. POST to /api/superadmin/leagues with the test data
testCases.expectedResult: Status 200 with payload {isActive:true, teamSize:32, groupCount:2, playoffStartGw:31, enabledChips:['D','W','C'], teamCount:32, currentGameweek:null}
testCases.postconditions: leagues row exists with format='tvt', 2 PL groups ('A','B'), 32 placeholder teams distributed 16/16
testCases.author: qa-tester

gapFlags.issue: TVT-8 default playoffStartGw resolves to 36, which is also the upper bound of the validation range — leaving zero playoff weeks. Need product owner to confirm whether (a) the default should be lower for TVT-8 to actually allow playoffs, (b) TVT-8 deliberately runs a regular-season-only format, or (c) the upper bound should be raised. TC-LEAGUE-005 pins current behaviour as a regression.
gapFlags.resolution: Resolved 2026-05-24 as a misread by the BA. The TVT-8 playoff stage with playoffStartGw=36 actually spans three gameweeks (GW36-GW38): SF is a 1-leg tie at GW36, Final and 3rd-Place are 2-leg ties at GW37+GW38. Verified against advance-playoffs/route.ts:805-841 (advanceSF8 creates 8T-FINAL and 8T-3RD with gw1Num=playoffStartGw+1, gw2Num=playoffStartGw+2), fixtures.ts:106 (isPlayoffs returns true for [playoffStartGw, 38]), and playoffs.ts:264 (ensurePlayoffGws auto-creates the GW rows). No product-owner decision needed; BR-LEAGUE-008 updated to describe the actual behaviour. Linked DEF-LEAGUE-001 closed as Wont Fix.

gapFlags.issue: PATCH /api/superadmin/leagues/[id] accepts any array for enabledChips and stores it verbatim — it bypasses the '3 unique entries from {W,D,C,SL,CB,UD}' rule enforced at creation. Need product owner to confirm whether PATCH should apply the same validation or whether superadmin is intentionally trusted to write arbitrary chip arrays post-creation. TC-LEAGUE-034 pins current (lax) behaviour as a regression.

On league creation, initialBudget is forced to 100_000_000 for non-auction formats even though the column has no functional effect for TVT/Triple Crown. Need product owner to confirm whether (a) the column should be left null for non-auction formats, (b) the schema default is sufficient and the explicit write should be removed, or (c) leave as-is for forward compatibility. TC-LEAGUE-063 pins current behaviour as a regression.

defects.title: TVT-8 default playoffStartGw=36 leaves zero playoff gameweeks
defects.description: When creating a TVT-8 league, the resolved default for playoffStartGw is 36 — which equals the upper bound of the accepted range (31-36). Because league-stage gameweeks run from GW1 to playoffStartGw-1 and playoff gameweeks run from playoffStartGw onward, defaulting to 36 means the league stage uses GW1-35 and the playoff stage has only GW36 — but the format requires at least Semi-finals + Final (2 GWs), making the default un-shippable without manual override.
defects.expectedBehaviour: TVT-8 should ship a default playoffStartGw that leaves at least 2 GWs of playoffs (e.g. 36 → 36 is wrong; 35 leaves GW35-38, enough for SF + 3rd-place + Final).
defects.actualBehaviour: Server resolves playoffStartGw to 36 for TVT-8 (src/app/api/superadmin/leagues/route.ts:94), and validation accepts 36 inclusive — admin creates the league without warning but is unable to run playoffs without first editing the value.
defects.notes:
Three resolutions possible: (a) change default for TVT-8 to a lower number (e.g. 35) so SF + Final fit; (b) accept TVT-8 as regular-season-only and remove the playoff machinery from the format; (c) raise the upper bound past 36. (a) is the lowest-risk. [DEV-QUESTION 2026-05-24] The defect's actualBehaviour appears to be incorrect on inspection. The TVT-8 playoff system does not stop at playoffStartGw — it spans GW(start)..GW38 (see src/lib/formats/tvt/fixtures.ts:106 isPlayoffs(), and src/lib/formats/tvt/playoffs.ts:264 ensurePlayoffGws() which auto-creates GWs from playoffStartGw to 38). With playoffStartGw=36, TVT-8 runs SF at GW36 (1-legged), Final at GW37+GW38 (2-legged), and 3rd-Place at GW37+GW38 (2-legged) — see generate-playoffs/route.ts:163-202 and advance-playoffs/route.ts:805-841. This matches the e2e spec tests/league-types/tvt-8.spec.ts:4 ("playoffs start at GW36 (Semi-finals → Final)") and the existing assertion on line 54 (`playoffStartGw === 36`). So the current default of 36 IS runnable and matches the documented design. Requesting BA re-review: is the original concern based on (i) a misreading of how playoffStartGw maps to the SF/Final/3rd-place schedule, (ii) a desire to leave a buffer GW for rescheduling, or (iii) a separate concern about admin-UI labeling (only GW36 shown as 'playoff stage' even though GW37/38 are also used)? If (i), close as Wont Fix and update GAP-LEAGUE-001. If (ii)/(iii), the fix is different from option (a) in the notes — please specify before code change. No code change applied pending BA decision.
[BA-DISPOSITION]: 2026-05-24 — Wont Fix; closed as misread.
defects.resolution: Original BA description was a misread of the TVT-8 playoff schedule. TVT-8 with the default playoffStartGw=36 actually produces 3 GWs of playoffs: Semi-finals as a 1-leg tie at GW36, and both the Final and the 3rd-Place play-off as 2-leg ties scheduled at GW37 (leg 1) + GW38 (leg 2). Verified against src/app/api/admin/[leagueId]/advance-playoffs/route.ts:805-841 (advanceSF8 creates 8T-FINAL and 8T-3RD with gw1Num=playoffStartGw+1, gw2Num=playoffStartGw+2), src/lib/formats/tvt/fixtures.ts:106 (isPlayoffs returns true for [playoffStartGw, 38]), and src/lib/formats/tvt/playoffs.ts:264 (ensurePlayoffGws auto-creates GW rows from playoffStartGw to 38). The code is correct as-is and matches the documented design (also asserted in tests/league-types/tvt-8.spec.ts). No code change needed; BR-LEAGUE-008 has been rewritten to accurately describe the schedule and GAP-LEAGUE-001 has been resolved.

defects.title: PATCH /api/superadmin/leagues/[id] bypasses enabled-chips validation
defects.description: Creating a league via POST validates that enabledChips is an array of exactly 3 unique entries from {W,D,C,SL,CB,UD}. Updating that field via PATCH /api/superadmin/leagues/[id] accepts ANY array (including empty, duplicate, or invalid codes) and stores it verbatim. This means a superadmin can edit a TVT league post-creation into a chip configuration the chip-submission API will then reject — silently breaking the league mid-season.
defects.expectedBehaviour: PATCH should apply the same '3 unique entries from {W,D,C,SL,CB,UD}' validation as POST.
defects.actualBehaviour: PATCH whitelist accepts enabledChips and writes it without revalidating shape or contents.
defects.notes: Likely fix: extract the POST chip-array validation into a helper and reuse it in PATCH. Alternative is to document that PATCH is superadmin-trusted and only POST should be used by non-superadmin tooling — but PATCH is already superadmin-only, so consistency wins.

defects.title: initialBudget unconditionally written as 100_000_000 for non-auction formats
defects.description: On league creation the server forces initialBudget=100_000_000 for TVT and Triple Crown formats even though the column has no functional effect outside auction leagues. The value is harmless today but creates noise in admin tooling (the field shows up populated for non-auction leagues) and could mislead future readers into thinking it has meaning for TVT/TC.
defects.expectedBehaviour: For non-auction formats, initialBudget should be left null (or set to 0) so it is obvious from a row inspection that the field is irrelevant.
defects.actualBehaviour: Server resolves resolvedBudget = format === 'auction' ? (initialBudget ?? 100_000_000) : 100_000_000 — always writes 100M for non-auction.
defects.notes: Cosmetic/cleanup only — no functional impact. Defer until a broader cleanup pass through the leagues table or document the column as 'auction-only; non-auction values are ignored'.
